real_gpu_fusion_rejection.comparison: 100-step stock versus fused weighted backward, both batch one; failure occurred before candidate batch-eight evaluation
real_gpu_fusion_rejection.decision: Remove fused backward entirely. Retain unmodified compute_guidance_gradient, including mean-loss times actual batch size, separate component differentiation, configured component clipping and weighted sum, and per-input global clipping. Do not raise tolerance.
real_gpu_fusion_rejection.causality_limit: The alternative backward evaluation produced the measured difference; per-step attribution of the accumulated difference was not measured.

batching_policy: New GPU pilots compare repeat stock batch-one runs exactly and compare candidate batches/permutations at the unchanged fixed relative tolerance. A failed family must use a separately validated smaller batch, ultimately batch one; use independent jobs/GPUs to recover throughput without altering per-input arithmetic.
